job.title: Associate/Senior Associate | Construction Disputes
job.description:
If you’re a commercial or civil litigator who enjoys complex disputes but would like to develop a genuine specialisation, this is an opportunity worth exploring.

Our client is an established commercial law firm with a highly regarded construction practice and a strong, long-term client base across the commercial, industrial, education, health, hospitality, residential and infrastructure sectors.

Due to continued growth, the team is looking for an Associate or Senior Associate to join its construction disputes practice.

The Opportunity
Working closely with an experienced Partner in a small, hands-on construction team, you’ll have the opportunity to develop genuine expertise across the full construction project lifecycle.

Your work will include:

  • Construction and commercial disputes
  • Court proceedings and litigation
  • Security of Payment matters
  • Contractual disputes and risk management
  • Advice arising during project delivery
  • Post-completion disputes
  • Exposure to front-end construction matters as the practice continues to grow
  • Direct interaction with clients and opportunities to attend client sites


The firm acts for a diverse range of construction industry participants, including developers, builders, contractors, consultants, architects, engineers, manufacturers, trades and subcontractors.

Importantly, you don’t need to already be a construction specialist. This could be an excellent move for a capable commercial or civil litigator who wants to build a long-term career in construction law.

Why Consider This Role?
Become a genuine specialist
You’ll work alongside experienced construction lawyers who are invested in developing your technical capability, with exposure to interesting disputes and the commercial realities sitting behind them.

Real client exposure
This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your career several layers removed from the client. You’ll gain exposure to a strong repeat-client base, learn where instructions come from and develop meaningful commercial relationships.

A firm that takes development seriously
There is a genuine focus on training and broader professional development, including leadership programs featuring speakers from business and other industries. Lawyers are also encouraged to understand their clients’ businesses and the technical issues behind construction projects, not simply the law.

Career development without a one-size-fits-all pathway
Not everyone wants to become a Partner, and that’s understood here. If your goal is instead to become an exceptional technical lawyer, that pathway will be supported too.

A grown-up culture
The firm has a hardworking team that takes pride in the quality of its work, while recognising that work isn’t everything. There is a collaborative approach to learning, a good gender mix across levels and a professional but down-to-earth environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • A genuine interest in specialising in construction disputes
  • Confidence dealing directly with clients and taking increasing ownership of matters
  • 3+ years’ PAE
  • Commercial litigation, civil litigation and/or construction disputes experience
  • Strong drafting, analytical and technical skills
  • Exposure to running or assisting with court proceedings
  • Security of Payment experience would be advantageous, but isn’t essential


The Package & Environment

  • Competitive market salary
  • Bonus structure
  • Full-time permanent position
  • Sydney CBD location, close to Wynyard
  • Modern office fit-out
  • Flexibility to work from home as needed
  • Established administrative and paralegal support
  • Strong emphasis on technical training, mentorship and career development


Interested?

For a confidential discussion, contact Elizabeth at Connected People on 0455 326 852 for a chat, or apply directly for further information.

All enquiries will be treated in strict confidence.

Working closely with a dynamic, highly experienced Partner and Accredited Specialist in Family Law, you will have the opportunity to further develop your expertise while managing a diverse range of interesting, complex family law matters.

The role offers an excellent balance of autonomy and support, with the opportunity to take ownership of your matters while benefiting from the guidance and mentorship of a highly respected specialist.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing a diverse caseload of family law matters, including property settlements, parenting disputes, divorce and financial agreements.

  • Drafting legal documents, agreements, correspondence and court applications.

  • Working collaboratively with the Family Law team to achieve positive client outcomes.

About You

We are looking for a capable and personable Family Lawyer who genuinely enjoys their area of practice and takes pride in delivering exceptional client service.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • 5–10 years post-admission experience, predominantly in Family Law.
  • Strong technical knowledge across a broad range of family law matters.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and client relationship skills.
  • A compassionate and professional approach to supporting clients through challenging circumstances.
  • The ability to manage matters independently while enjoying the benefits of working within a collaborative team.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a commitment to delivering quality legal advice.

What's on Offer?

Turnbull Hill offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced Family Lawyer looking for a rewarding long-term career with a respected Newcastle firm.

  • Competitive salary package reflective of your skills and experience.
  • A supportive working environment with flexibility to help support work/life balance.

  • Interesting and varied work across a broad range of family law matters.

  • Career development opportunities within a well-established and respected firm.

If you're an experienced Family Lawyer considering your next career move, this is an excellent opportunity to join a firm where you can continue to develop professionally while enjoying a supportive and flexible working environment.
